name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: DSH Desktop shell: Electron window that supervises a local dsh web Host (MVP-A loopback)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; copyFileSync('src/dsh-desktop.d.ts', 'lib/dsh-desktop.d.ts')"
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && pnpm run ensure-host-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run ensure-host-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run ensure-host-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run ensure-host-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run ensure-host-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage
